remotes.title: Magic Remote MR20

A pairing file reading Name = LGE MR20: test/test-telemetry.js

remotes.title: Magic Remote MR22GN
sources: C2, webOS 9.2.2: the microphone and Google Assistant buttons (docs/HOME-ASSISTANT-REMOTE-BUTTONS.md)
Remote name read from a C2's pairing data: test/test-remotebattery.js

remotes.title: Magic Remote MR24
sources: Remote names read from TVs: LGE MR24 (test/test-telemetry.js) and LGE MR24N (docs/development/TV-RESEARCH.md)
remotes.notes: LGE MR24N is a name TVs report; treating it as the same family as the MR24 is an assumption.

remotes.title: Magic Remote MR25GA
sources: C5, webOS 11.2.0: the presses lginput2 logs by name, KEY_HOMEDASHBOARD, KEY_MULTIKEY, KEY_GUIDE, KEY_VOICE (AI), KEY_ALEXAVOICE, KEY_NETFLIX and KEY_AMAZON (docs/development/TV-RESEARCH.md)
The Disney+ button is a C5 key in LG's filters; that this remote has it is not confirmed
remotes.notes: Also has a 123 button, which stays in the compositor and cannot be changed, and the Home key.

remotes.title: Magic Remote MR26GA
sources: OLED48C56LB, webOS 10.3.0, 17 November 2026: presses of these keys read from the remote's input device, and CH+ and CH- received by the key filter
This remote has no number keys
remotes.notes: The name the TV reports for this remote has not been read yet; LGE MR26GA follows the others' pattern. The rest of its buttons are to be listed.
